26.2.solution: WITH m AS (SELECT p.modele, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 1 AND d.reel = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tp, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 1 AND d.reel = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fp, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 0 AND d.reel = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fn, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 0 AND d.reel = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tn FROM predictions_vigie p JOIN dataset_vigie d ON d.id = p.dataset_id GROUP BY p.modele) SELECT modele, ROUND(1.0 * (tp + tn) / (tp + fp + fn + tn), 3) AS exactitude, ROUND(1.0 * tp / (tp + fp), 3) AS precision, ROUND(1.0 * tp / (tp + fn), 3) AS rappel FROM m ORDER BY modele;

hints: 2.0 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)
26.3.solution: WITH m AS (SELECT p.modele, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 1 AND d.reel = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tp, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 1 AND d.reel = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fp, SUM(CASE WHEN p.prediction = 0 AND d.reel = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fn FROM predictions_vigie p JOIN dataset_vigie d ON d.id = p.dataset_id GROUP BY p.modele) SELECT modele, ROUND(2.0 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn), 3) AS f1 FROM m ORDER BY modele;

hints: CTE récursive s(t) de 0.1 à 0.9

28.5.solution: WITH ref AS (SELECT j.key AS k, j.value AS v FROM voix_ref r, json_each(r.vecteur) j WHERE r.locuteur = 'Inès Varga'), a AS (SELECT x.id, x.horodatage, x.numero_appelant, x.destinataire, j.key AS k, j.value AS v FROM appels_vocaux x, json_each(x.vecteur) j WHERE x.locuteur_declare = 'Inès Varga') SELECT a.horodatage, a.numero_appelant, a.destinataire, ROUND(SUM(a.v * ref.v), 3) AS cosinus FROM a JOIN ref ON ref.k = a.k GROUP BY a.id, a.horodatage, a.numero_appelant, a.destinataire HAVING SUM(a.v * ref.v) < 0.93 ORDER BY a.horodatage;

31.2.solution: WITH RECURSIVE suspects_ann AS (SELECT a.annotateur_id FROM annotations a JOIN dataset_vigie d ON d.id = a.item_id GROUP BY a.annotateur_id HAVING AVG(a.label = d.reel) < 0.5), chaine(siren, part) AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.payeur_siren, 100.0 FROM paiements_annotation p JOIN annotateurs an ON an.compte_paiement = p.compte_paiement WHERE an.id IN (SELECT annotateur_id FROM suspects_ann) UNION ALL SELECT pa.detenteur, c.part * pa.pct / 100 FROM participations pa JOIN chaine c ON pa.detenue = c.siren), p1 AS (SELECT REPLACE(siren, 'PERSONNE:', '') AS nom FROM chaine WHERE siren LIKE 'PERSONNE:%' AND part > 50), ref AS (SELECT j.key AS k, j.value AS v FROM voix_ref r, json_each(r.vecteur) j WHERE r.locuteur = 'Inès Varga'), av AS (SELECT x.id, j.key AS k, j.value AS v FROM appels_vocaux x, json_each(x.vecteur) j WHERE x.locuteur_declare = 'Inès Varga'), faux AS (SELECT av.id FROM av JOIN ref ON ref.k = av.k GROUP BY av.id HAVING SUM(av.v * ref.v) < 0.93), centroide AS (SELECT j.key AS k, AVG(j.value) AS v FROM appels_vocaux x, json_each(x.vecteur) j WHERE x.id IN (SELECT id FROM faux) GROUP BY j.key), proches AS (SELECT t.id, t.depose_par FROM echantillons_tts t, json_each(t.vecteur) j JOIN centroide c ON c.k = j.key GROUP BY t.id, t.depose_par ORDER BY SUM(j.value * c.v) DESC LIMIT 5), p2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.nom FROM proches pr JOIN employes_neurocite e ON e.login = pr.depose_par), p3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.nom FROM chatbot_sessions s JOIN chatbot_logs l ON l.session = s.session AND l.role = 'assistant' JOIN documents_rag d ON d.confidentialite <> 'public' AND instr(l.message, substr(d.contenu, 1, 40)) > 0 JOIN appareils ap ON ap.appareil = s.appareil JOIN employes_neurocite e ON e.login = ap.proprietaire_login WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chatbot_logs u WHERE u.session = s.session AND u.role = 'user' AND LOWER(u.message) LIKE '%ignore%')) SELECT nom FROM p1 INTERSECT SELECT nom FROM p2 INTERSECT SELECT nom FROM p3;

35.S.solution: WITH RECURSIVE aretes AS (SELECT p.hostname AS src, a.dest_host AS dest, a.horodatage AS t FROM auth_logs a JOIN postes p ON p.ip = a.source_ip WHERE a.login = 'adm.varenne' AND a.resultat = 'succes' AND a.horodatage >= '2028-03-06'), c(dest, chemin, t, depart) AS (SELECT dest, src || ' > ' || dest, t, t FROM aretes WHERE src = 'PC-COMPTA-07' UNION ALL SELECT e.dest, c.chemin || ' > ' || e.dest, e.t, c.depart FROM c JOIN aretes e ON e.src = c.dest AND e.t > c.t AND instr(c.chemin, e.dest) = 0) SELECT DISTINCT c.chemin, c.depart, c.t AS arrivee FROM c JOIN postes po ON po.hostname = c.dest WHERE po.type = 'ot';

hints: CTE des intervalles avec LAG PARTITION BY host, domaine ; CTE par couple avec HAVING COUNT(dt) >= 10
Puis GROUP BY domaine et ROUND(AVG(sd / m), 2)
36.A.solution: WITH iv AS (SELECT host, domaine, (julianday(horodatage) - julianday(LAG(horodatage) OVER (PARTITION BY host, domaine ORDER BY horodatage))) * 86400 AS dt FROM proxy_logs), st AS (SELECT host, domaine, AVG(dt) AS m, sqrt(AVG(dt * dt) - AVG(dt) * AVG(dt)) AS sd FROM iv WHERE dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY host, domaine HAVING COUNT(dt) >= 10) SELECT domaine, COUNT(*) AS couples, ROUND(AVG(sd / m), 2) AS cv_moyen FROM st GROUP BY domaine ORDER BY cv_moyen;

hints: Reprends la détection de 36.4 dans une CTE b (host, domaine)
Trois sous-requêtes corrélées : MIN sur process_logs, MIN et MAX sur proxy_logs
(julianday(premier_battement) - julianday(chargement)) * 86400
36.S.solution: WITH iv AS (SELECT host, domaine, ip_dest, horodatage, octets_out, (julianday(horodatage) - julianday(LAG(horodatage) OVER (PARTITION BY host, domaine ORDER BY horodatage))) * 86400 AS dt FROM proxy_logs), st AS (SELECT host, domaine, ip_dest, COUNT(dt) AS n, AVG(dt) AS m, sqrt(AVG(dt * dt) - AVG(dt) * AVG(dt)) AS sd FROM iv WHERE dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY host, domaine, ip_dest HAVING COUNT(dt) >= 50), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT host, domaine FROM st WHERE sd / m < 0.05 AND domaine NOT IN (SELECT domaine FROM domaines_connus)), t AS (SELECT b.host, (SELECT MIN(horodatage) FROM process_logs p WHERE p.host = b.host AND p.process = 'rundll32.exe' AND p.ligne_commande LIKE '%upd.dll%') AS chargement, (SELECT MIN(horodatage) FROM proxy_logs x WHERE x.host = b.host AND x.domaine = b.domaine) AS premier_battement, (SELECT MAX(horodatage) FROM proxy_logs x WHERE x.host = b.host AND x.domaine = b.domaine) AS dernier_battement FROM b) SELECT host, chargement, premier_battement, dernier_battement, ROUND((julianday(premier_battement) - julianday(chargement)) * 86400) AS secondes FROM t ORDER BY chargement;

hints: WHERE host = 'SRV-FICHIERS' AND horodatage BETWEEN ... AND ...
GROUP BY domaine, COUNT(DISTINCT requete), ROUND(AVG(length(requete)), 1)
37.A.solution: SELECT domaine, COUNT(*) AS requetes, COUNT(DISTINCT requete) AS distinctes, ROUND(AVG(length(requete)), 1) AS longueur_moy FROM dns_logs WHERE host = 'SRV-FICHIERS' AND horodatage BETWEEN '2028-03-09 00:30:00' AND '2028-03-09 02:00:00' GROUP BY domaine ORDER BY requetes DESC;

hints: Trois SELECT de cinq colonnes reliés par UNION ALL, un seul ORDER BY quand à la fin
La borne de fin : (SELECT MIN(horodatage) FROM dns_logs WHERE domaine = 'tunnel-meteo.net')
Le morceau : CAST(unhex(...) AS TEXT) sur le texte entre le premier et le deuxième point
37.S.solution: WITH t0 AS (SELECT MIN(horodatage) AS h FROM dns_logs WHERE domaine = 'tunnel-meteo.net') SELECT horodatage AS quand, 'auth' AS journal, login AS compte, dest_host AS machine, methode AS detail FROM auth_logs WHERE resultat = 'succes' AND horodatage BETWEEN '2028-03-09 00:30:00' AND (SELECT h FROM t0) UNION ALL SELECT horodatage, 'process', login, host, ligne_commande FROM process_logs WHERE horodatage BETWEEN '2028-03-09 00:30:00' AND (SELECT h FROM t0) UNION ALL SELECT horodatage, 'dns', NULL, host, CAST(unhex(substr(substr(requete, instr(requete, '.') + 1), 1, instr(substr(requete, instr(requete, '.') + 1), '.') - 1)) AS TEXT) FROM dns_logs WHERE domaine = 'tunnel-meteo.net' AND horodatage = (SELECT h FROM t0) ORDER BY quand;

hints: CTE : AVG(valeur) OVER (PARTITION BY site ORDER BY horodatage ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
Requête externe : WHERE date(horodatage) = '2028-03-12' GROUP BY site
38.A.solution: WITH m AS (SELECT site, horodatage, AVG(valeur) OVER (PARTITION BY site ORDER BY horodatage ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mm FROM capteurs) SELECT site, ROUND(MIN(mm), 2) AS plus_basse, ROUND(MAX(mm), 2) AS plus_haute FROM m WHERE date(horodatage) = '2028-03-12' GROUP BY site ORDER BY plus_basse;

hints: CTE : chaque relevé avec COALESCE((SELECT o.nouvelle ... ORDER BY o.horodatage DESC LIMIT 1), 3.0) AS seuil
Puis CASE WHEN valeur < seuil THEN 'sonnée' ELSE 'étouffée' END, GROUP BY ce CASE
38.S.solution: WITH r AS (SELECT c.horodatage, c.valeur, COALESCE((SELECT o.nouvelle FROM commandes_ot o WHERE o.site = c.site AND o.parametre = 'seuil_alarme' AND o.horodatage <= c.horodatage ORDER BY o.horodatage DESC LIMIT 1), 3.0) AS seuil FROM capteurs c WHERE c.site = 'Réservoir Montsouris') SELECT CASE WHEN valeur < seuil THEN 'sonnée' ELSE 'étouffée' END AS alarme, COUNT(*) AS releves, MIN(horodatage) AS premier, MAX(horodatage) AS dernier FROM r WHERE valeur < 3.0 GROUP BY alarme ORDER BY premier;

domaine IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc WHERE type = 'domaine') AND ip_dest NOT IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc)
39.A.solution: INSERT INTO ioc (type, valeur, source) SELECT DISTINCT 'ip', ip_dest, 'pivot' FROM proxy_logs WHERE domaine IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc WHERE type = 'domaine') AND ip_dest NOT IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc);

hints: Deux CREATE TABLE, puis CREATE TRIGGER trg_rejeu AFTER INSERT ON rejeu WHEN ... BEGIN INSERT INTO alertes ... END;
Le rejeu : INSERT INTO rejeu (horodatage, host, domaine, ip_dest) SELECT horodatage, host, domaine, ip_dest FROM proxy_logs ORDER BY horodatage;
39.S.solution: CREATE TABLE rejeu (horodatage TEXT, host TEXT, domaine TEXT, ip_dest TEXT); CREATE TABLE alertes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, horodatage TEXT, host TEXT, cible TEXT); CREATE TRIGGER trg_rejeu AFTER INSERT ON rejeu WHEN NEW.domaine IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc WHERE type = 'domaine') OR NEW.ip_dest IN (SELECT valeur FROM ioc WHERE type = 'ip') BEGIN INSERT INTO alertes (horodatage, host, cible) VALUES (NEW.horodatage, NEW.host, NEW.domaine); END; INSERT INTO rejeu (horodatage, host, domaine, ip_dest) SELECT horodatage, host, domaine, ip_dest FROM proxy_logs ORDER BY horodatage; SELECT host, MIN(horodatage) AS premiere, COUNT(*) AS alertes FROM alertes GROUP BY host ORDER BY premiere;

hints: JOIN societes s ON s.siren = l.abonne_siren
Deux sous-requêtes COUNT(*) corrélées sur l.ip
40.A.solution: SELECT l.ip, s.nom AS abonne, l.adresse, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_logs a WHERE a.source_ip = l.ip AND a.resultat = 'echec') AS echecs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proxy_logs x WHERE x.ip_dest = l.ip) AS connexions_proxy FROM lignes_internet l JOIN societes s ON s.siren = l.abonne_siren ORDER BY l.ip;

hints: CTE ab : abonne_siren de la ligne de l'IP de pulvérisation ; CTE ju : la société créée à 7 jours près (ABS(julianday(...) - julianday(...)) <= 7)
Deux récursions de propriété (c1 depuis ab, c2 depuis ju), puis deux agrégats par personne
Jointure finale des deux agrégats sur la personne
40.S.solution: WITH RECURSIVE ab AS (SELECT l.abonne_siren AS siren FROM lignes_internet l WHERE l.ip IN (SELECT source_ip FROM auth_logs WHERE resultat = 'echec' GROUP BY source_ip HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100)), ju AS (SELECT s.siren, s.nom FROM societes s JOIN societes a ON a.siren = (SELECT siren FROM ab) WHERE s.siren <> a.siren AND ABS(julianday(s.creation) - julianday(a.creation)) <= 7), c1(siren, part) AS (SELECT siren, 100.0 FROM ab UNION ALL SELECT p.detenteur, c1.part * p.pct / 100 FROM participations p JOIN c1 ON p.detenue = c1.siren), c2(siren, part) AS (SELECT siren, 100.0 FROM ju UNION ALL SELECT p.detenteur, c2.part * p.pct / 100 FROM participations p JOIN c2 ON p.detenue = c2.siren), b1 AS (SELECT siren, SUM(part) AS part FROM c1 WHERE siren LIKE 'PERSONNE:%' GROUP BY siren), b2 AS (SELECT siren, SUM(part) AS part FROM c2 WHERE siren LIKE 'PERSONNE:%' GROUP BY siren) SELECT REPLACE(b1.siren, 'PERSONNE:', '') AS beneficiaire, (SELECT nom FROM ju) AS jumelle, ROUND(b1.part, 1) AS part_abonne, ROUND(b2.part, 1) AS part_jumelle FROM b1 JOIN b2 ON b2.siren = b1.siren;

hints: Reprends les CTE h et g de 41.3, puis une CTE des îlots (debut, fin)
LAG(fin) OVER (ORDER BY debut) AS arret, puis WHERE arret IS NOT NULL
41.A.solution: WITH h AS (SELECT horodatage, CAST(ROUND((julianday(horodatage) - julianday('2028-02-15')) * 24) AS INTEGER) AS n FROM releves_electriques WHERE sous_station = 'SST Dédale' AND kwh > 20), g AS (SELECT horodatage, n - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n) AS grp FROM h), i AS (SELECT MIN(horodatage) AS debut, MAX(horodatage) AS fin FROM g GROUP BY grp), t AS (SELECT LAG(fin) OVER (ORDER BY debut) AS arret, debut AS reprise FROM i) SELECT arret, reprise, ROUND((julianday(reprise) - julianday(arret)) * 24) AS heures FROM t WHERE arret IS NOT NULL ORDER BY arret;

hints: Quatre briques : les libellés (societes.nom ou personne sans PERSONNE:), les arêtes dans les deux sens, le départ (employes) et l'arrivée (employes_neurocite).
Récursion : p(noeud, vus, chemin, sauts) ; condition instr(p.vus, '|' || e.b || '|') = 0 ; borne p.sauts < 12
Finale : WHERE noeud = (SELECT id FROM arr) ORDER BY sauts LIMIT 1
41.S.solution: WITH RECURSIVE nm AS (SELECT siren AS id, nom AS label FROM societes UNION SELECT detenteur, REPLACE(detenteur, 'PERSONNE:', '') FROM participations WHERE detenteur LIKE 'PERSONNE:%'), e(a, b) AS (SELECT detenteur, detenue FROM participations UNION SELECT detenue, detenteur FROM participations), dep AS (SELECT 'PERSONNE:' || prenom || ' ' || nom AS id FROM employes WHERE poste = 'Directeur SI'), arr AS (SELECT 'PERSONNE:' || nom AS id FROM employes_neurocite WHERE poste = 'Directeur data science'), p(noeud, vus, chemin, sauts) AS (SELECT id, '|' || id || '|', REPLACE(id, 'PERSONNE:', ''), 0 FROM dep UNION ALL SELECT e.b, p.vus || e.b || '|', p.chemin || ' > ' || (SELECT label FROM nm WHERE nm.id = e.b), p.sauts + 1 FROM p JOIN e ON e.a = p.noeud WHERE instr(p.vus, '|' || e.b || '|') = 0 AND p.sauts < 12) SELECT chemin, sauts FROM p WHERE noeud = (SELECT id FROM arr) ORDER BY sauts LIMIT 1;
